name: qlrisk_price_collateral_swap
title: Price a CollateralSwap
description:
Price one Collateral Swap Transaction (qlrisk CollateralSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, receive_leg, deliver_leg, fee_rate_bp=0, fee_payment_frequency=quarterly, initial_margin_pct=2, variation_margin=true, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 60,000.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
